2609.26346.title: Blaming Across the Aisle: Political Contrasting and Blame Attribution in the Danish Parliament
2609.26346.paper_summary: Political discourse is widely perceived to be growing more hostile, yet robust evidence remains scarce. This study examines blame attribution in the Danish Parliament from 1997 to 2026, combining a purpose-built classifier, BlameBERT (F1: 0.80), with multilevel statistical modeling. The classifier is constructed using an annotation-efficient pipeline for blame attribution in low-to-mid resource languages. The results reveal a banana-shaped trajectory, with blame declining until around 2016 before entering a significant and sustained increase in recent years (2019-2026). Government status consistently influenced blame attribution - an effect we term political contrasting - with opposition parties blaming substantially more than governing parties. This effect was moderated by ideology: The blame-dampening effect of governing was less pronounced among right-wing parties, and ideological extremity amplified blame more strongly on the right. In recent years, the interaction between political wing and ideological extremity intensified, suggesting an ideological hardening of the blame rhetoric concentrated on the right of the political spectrum. Taken together, these patterns suggest that the perceived rise in harsh political language reflects not merely a general rhetorical drift, but an ideologically asymmetric hardening of political discourse. A sensitivity analysis showed that the conclusions were robust to varying classification thresholds.
2609.26346.paper_summary_zh: 政治話語普遍被認為越來越敵對，但堅實的證據仍然稀缺。這項研究考察了1997年至2026年丹麥國會中的責任歸屬，結合了專門構建的分類器BlameBERT（F1: 0.80）和多層次統計建模。該分類器是使用一個高效的標註流程來進行低至中資源語言的責任歸屬構建的。結果顯示出一個香蕉形的軌跡，責任在2016年前持續下降，然後在最近幾年（2019-2026）進入了一個顯著且持續的增長階段。政府地位持續影響責任歸屬——我們稱之為政治對比——反對黨的責任歸屬明顯高於執政黨。這一效應受到意識形態的調節：執政黨的責任減少效應在右翼政黨中不那麼明顯，而意識形態的極端性則在右翼更強烈地放大了責任。在最近幾年，政治派別與意識形態極端性之間的互動加劇，這表明責任話語在政治光譜的右側出現了意識形態上的硬化。綜合來看，這些模式表明，對於嚴厲政治語言的感知上升不僅僅反映了一種一般的修辭漂移，而是政治話語的意識形態不對稱硬化。一項敏感性分析顯示，結論對不同的分類閾值具有穩健性。
